base.note: base rides the scapula on the user's scapula handler

model: base_slip.py: handler = acromion marker cluster analogue; per-axis ISB scapula error angles vs humeral elevation/plane from Karduna 2001, van Andel 2009, Lempereur 2014 + 4.2 mm translation slip (McQuade & Smidt 1998); lever GH - flat of the acromion from the OpenSim Seth 2016 scapula, scaled to the rig
note: design-independent for a spherical chain on a girdle mount: only the handler (grip, footprint), the motions and a passive slider can change it
